description: This file defines the StoreLandingDescription class, a data entity representing the descriptive content for store landing pages, including fields such as title, description, keywords, homePageContent, and associated language.

classes.name: StoreLandingDescription
classes.description: A serializable Java class that holds store landing page metadata, including title, description, keywords, homepage content, and language reference.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the store landing page.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description for the store landing page.

methods.name: setHomePageContent
methods.description: Sets the homepage content for the store landing page.

methods.name: getHomePageContent
methods.description: Retrieves the homepage content for the store landing page.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets the keywords associated with the store landing page.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves the keywords associated with the store landing page.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the store landing page.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title for the store landing page.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Associates a Language object with this store landing description.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Language object for this store landing description.
